parameters.name: --name
parameters.help: The name of the container registry. It should be specified in lower case. You can configure the default registry name using `az configure --defaults acr=<registry name>`.

parameters.name: --resource-group
parameters.help: Name of resource group. You can configure the default group using `az configure --defaults group=<name>`.

parameters.name: --sku
parameters.help: The SKU of the container registry.

parameters.name: --admin-enabled
parameters.help: Indicates whether the admin user is enabled.

parameters.name: --allow-exports
parameters.help: Configure exportPolicy to allow/disallow artifacts from being exported from this registry. Artifacts can be exported via import or transfer operations. For more information, please visit https://aka.ms/acr/export-policy. WARNING: Argument '--allow-exports' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --allow-metadata-search
parameters.help: Enable or disable the metadata-search feature for the registry. If not specified, this is set to disabled by default. WARNING: Argument '--allow-metadata-search' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --dnl-scope
parameters.help: Domain name label scope will add a hash to the resource name. The resulting login server name will be in the format `registryname`-`hash`.azurecr-io. Default is Unsecure. WARNING: Argument '--dnl-scope' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --location
parameters.help: Location. You can configure the default location using `az configure --defaults location=<location>`.

parameters.name: --tags
parameters.help: Space-separated tags: key[=value] [key[=value]...]. Use '' to clear existing tags.

parameters.name: --workspace
parameters.help: Name or ID of the Log Analytics workspace to send registry diagnostic logs to. All events will be enabled. You can use "az monitor log-analytics workspace create" to create one. Extra billing may apply. WARNING: Argument '--workspace' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --writable-cache-repos
parameters.help: 'Enable or disable writing to repositories backed by cache rules. If not specified, this is set to Disabled by default'. WARNING: Argument '--writable-cache-repos' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --zone-redundancy
parameters.help: Indicates whether or not zone redundancy should be enabled for this registry or replication. For more information, such as supported locations, please visit https://aka.ms/acr/az. Zone-redundancy cannot be updated. Defaults to 'Disabled'. WARNING: Argument '--zone-redundancy' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --identity
parameters.help: Use assigned managed identity resource id or name if in the same resource group.

parameters.name: --key-encryption-key
parameters.help: Key vault key uri. To enable automated rotation, provide a version-less key uri. For manual rotation, provide a versioned key uri.

parameters.name: --acquire-policy-token
parameters.help: Acquiring an Azure Policy token automatically for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --change-reference
parameters.help: The related change reference ID for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --allow-trusted-services
parameters.help: Allow trusted Azure Services to access network restricted registries. For more information, please visit https://aka.ms/acr/trusted-services. The Default is to allow.

parameters.name: --data-endpoint-enabled
parameters.help: Enable dedicated data endpoint for client firewall configuration.

parameters.name: --default-action
parameters.help: Default action to apply when no rule matches. Only applicable to Premium SKU.

parameters.name: --endpoint-protocol
parameters.help: The endpoint protocol for the registry. WARNING: Argument '--endpoint-protocol' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --public-network-enabled
parameters.help: Allow public network access for the container registry. The Default is to allow.

parameters.name: --regional-endpoints
parameters.help: Indicates whether or not regional endpoints should be enabled for the registry. WARNING: Argument '--regional-endpoints' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --role-assignment-mode
parameters.help: Role assignment mode of the registry. For more information on this feature, see https://aka.ms/acr/auth/abac. The Default is rbac.

parameters.name: --debug
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity to show all debug logs.

parameters.name: --help
parameters.help: Show this help message and exit.

parameters.name: --only-show-errors
parameters.help: Only show errors, suppressing warnings.

parameters.name: --output
parameters.help: Output format.

parameters.name: --query
parameters.help: JMESPath query string. See http://jmespath.org/ for more information and examples.

parameters.name: --subscription
parameters.help: Name or ID of subscription. You can configure the default subscription using `az account set -s NAME_OR_ID`.

parameters.name: --verbose
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity. Use --debug for full debug logs.
